interpretation: Predicted model changes and numerical refinement, not measured aircraft acceptance.
refinement_rule: Steady speed/RPM 1%; smooth pulse axis peak/speed and throttle endpoint 5%. Denominator floors are 1 m/s, 1 RPM and 0.1 rad/s. Nonlinear and stochastic cases are descriptive.

candidate_trajectory.interpretation: Body q integral is descriptive. The independent path metric unwraps atan2(-world-down velocity, velocity along the initial vertical plane); cross-track distance and velocity describe plane departure. None alone proves a completed loop.
